scoring_justification: Frequency is a fixed deterministic quantity from DFPT; a complete recompute would require running Quantum ESPRESSO/Phonopy which is infeasible in the verifier sandbox, so the reported value is compared to the paper-reported gold with tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: T peak frequency gold value (1078 cm⁻¹) from the paper's DFPT calculation (VASP/PBE+D3) for the ABBA four-layer model.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 9 and Section 3: 'the mode at 1078 cm⁻¹, which involves atoms from L1 and L2, can be associated to a combination of the stretching of the sp³-C bonds with an optical out-of-plane (ZO) mode of graphene membrane.'
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly taken from the paper's reported DFPT eigenfrequency at Γ for the T peak mode.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This is the exact numerical value the paper reports for the T peak; it is the target for reproduction.

outputs.description: DFPT-computed phonon frequency of the Raman T peak mode, reported in cm⁻¹. The hidden checker compares this value to the paper-reported DFPT result with a tolerance to account for differences in DFT code, pseudopotentials, and convergence settings.

output_contract.notes: The scored artifact is the frequency of the Raman-active mode that corresponds to the T peak in the ABBA-stacked partially hydrogenated four-layer model. The checker uses a tolerance-based comparison (T0 result-level) against the hidden gold value.
